title: Uniform noise mass at the lower endpoint
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with $|\Omega|\ge 2$, and let $x,y\in\Omega$. At $\rho=-1/(|\Omega|-1)$, the uniform extended noise mass from $x$ to $y$ is $0$ if $y=x$ and $1/(|\Omega|-1)$ if $y\ne x$.
